title: Breaking Bad — Say My Name (Brown Meth Deal)
subtitle: 35mm High-Noon New Mexico Desert · Max-3 Cast: Damon, Hooman & Zach

setups.BB2_WIDE: High-noon New Mexico desert standoff; older matte-black Chrysler sedan on left beside Damon (Heisenberg black porkpie hat, dark rectangular glasses, black zip jacket) and Zach (olive desert utility jacket beside open trunk stacked with translucent brown meth bags); sleek matte-black SUV on right beside Hooman (black leather jacket, open-collar white dress shirt, carrying gleaming metallic Magic Cone).
setups.BB2_DAMON: Tight MCU on Damon (Heisenberg: black porkpie hat, dark rectangular glasses, black zip jacket) framed left-center against blazing turquoise New Mexico sky and ochre desert horizon.
setups.BB2_HOOMAN: Medium close-up on Hooman (black leather jacket over open-collar white dress shirt, carrying gleaming metallic Magic Cone) framed center-right against pale blue desert clouds with black SUV behind.
setups.BB2_ZACH: Medium close-up on Zach (olive desert utility jacket) framed slightly right beside open black sedan trunk stacked with glistening brown meth ziplocks under harsh desert sun.
setups.BB2_CLIMAX_FX: Static wide desert practical-FX angle matching BB2_WIDE: Damon standing rigid while a pressurized torrent of thick brown diarrhea blasts violently across the sand, drenching Hooman's Italian loafers and splattering the chrome grille of the black SUV.
setups.BB2_HOOMAN_POST: Edited from BB2_HOOMAN: shaken Hooman holding the speckled Magic Cone with dark brown splatters across his leather lapel under blinding desert sun.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide desert establishing standoff beside parked black sedan loaded with brown meth and matte-black SUV; heat shimmer rises off the sand.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman squinting smugly under noon desert sun holding gleaming metallic Magic Cone.
shots.dialogue: Hoobeeee? Chetoreeee, Damon! Why you stand in middle of desert sweating like old yogurt, dood?
shots.tts: Hoobee? Chetoreee, Damon! Why you stand in middle of desert sweating like old yogurt, dood?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Dead-still MCU on Damon in Heisenberg porkpie hat and dark rectangular glasses against turquoise sky.
shots.dialogue: Cut the small talk, Hooman. You wanted a sit-down on the brown meth. Put your offer on the table.
shots.tts: [cold, gravelly, ramrod-straight Heisenberg deadpan] Cut the small talk, Hooman. You wanted a sit-down on the brown meth. Put your offer on the table.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman raising the gleaming metallic Magic Cone in sunlight.
shots.dialogue: Look at this stuff, dood. Ninety-nine percent pure brown meth. Best batch in whole Southwest, and everybody who touch it explode from stomach in twenty minute.
shots.tts: Look at this stuff, dood. Ninety-nine percent pure brown meth. Best batch in whole Southwest, and everybody who touch it explode from stomach in twenty minute.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on Zach beside the open black sedan trunk stacked with brown meth crystals, glancing worriedly toward Damon.
shots.dialogue: Dude, I don't think you realize how pale you look right now. You tested a pinch before your morning Aquabike ride—just hear him out.
shots.tts: [earnest, worried, urgent boyish tone] Dude, I don't think you realize how pale you look right now. You tested a pinch before your morning Aquabike ride—just hear him out.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Still MCU on Damon barely blinking beneath his porkpie hat.
shots.dialogue: Word, I test my own product, Zach. Keeps my Aquabike watts clean from swim exit to bike finish. Hooman, make your pitch.
shots.tts: [dry, calm deadpan] Word, I test my own product, Zach. Keeps my Aquabike watts clean from swim exit to bike finish. Hooman, make your pitch.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman holding the Magic Cone out like an unpatented miracle device.
shots.dialogue: Simple, dood. You stop cooking brown meth, sell me whole territory fifty-fifty, and right now I give you Magic Cone. One flush clean whole pipe in sixty second, finish!
shots.tts: Simple, dood. You stop cooking brown meth, sell me whole territory fifty-fifty, and right now I give you Magic Cone. One flush clean whole pipe in sixty second, finish!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked Heisenberg CU under blazing desert glare.
shots.dialogue: Fifty percent of my brown meth operation for a stainless-steel funnel.
shots.tts: [ice-cold disbelief, flat rhythmic cadence] Fifty percent of my brown meth operation for a stainless-steel funnel.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman gesturing passionately with the Magic Cone.
shots.dialogue: Dood, fuck that shit dood! Not regular funnel, this Magic Cone! Without Magic Cone, your stomach blow up right before Sunday Aquabike race, whole Malibu beach shut down!
shots.tts: Dood, fuck that shit dood! Not regular funnel, this Magic Cone! Without Magic Cone, your stomach blow up right before Sunday Aquabike race, whole Malibu beach shut down!

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on Zach beside open brown-meth trunk, lowering his voice anxiously.
shots.dialogue: Holy fudge, Damon, your core is literally shaking. Give him thirty percent, take the Magic Cone, and let's get out of this desert.
shots.tts: [tense, whispered panic] Holy fudge, Damon, your core is literally shaking. Give him thirty percent, take the Magic Cone, and let's get out of this desert.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Motionless Heisenberg MCU.
shots.dialogue: Nope. Stay out of it, Zach. Hooman, I trained six months for Aquabike—pure swim and bike, no run, zero margin. You're not taking half my empire.
shots.tts: [hard, immovable authority] Nope. Stay out of it, Zach. Hooman, I trained six months for Aquabike—pure swim and bike, no run, zero margin. You're not taking half my empire.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman smiling smugly, tilting the Magic Cone forward.
shots.dialogue: Listen to stomach, brother, sound like busted Porsche transmission! I got buyer in Westwood ready right now. Take Magic Cone, retire from brown meth, go ride little bicycle!
shots.tts: Listen to stomach, brother, sound like busted Porsche transmission! I got buyer in Westwood ready right now. Take Magic Cone, retire from brown meth, go ride little bicycle!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Cold deadpan MCU on Damon under porkpie hat.
shots.dialogue: Walk back to your SUV and try cooking brown meth yourself tomorrow, Hooman. Without my formula, you've got dirt in a ziplock.
shots.tts: [calm, ruthless menace] Walk back to your SUV and try cooking brown meth yourself tomorrow, Hooman. Without my formula, you've got dirt in a ziplock.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on Hooman leaning slightly forward, wide-eyed.
shots.dialogue: Dood, fuck that shit dood! Nobody hold back brown meth diarrhea on willpower alone! You got maybe thirty second before pants completely finished!
shots.tts: Dood, fuck that shit dood! Nobody hold back brown meth diarrhea on willpower alone! You got maybe thirty second before pants completely finished!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Ice-still CU on Damon not flinching a millimeter.
shots.dialogue: Then I guess we're both about to see how strong my core is.
shots.tts: [low, ominous stillness, utterly unfazed] Then I guess we're both about to see how strong my core is.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on Zach backing half a pace away from the trunk in dread.
shots.dialogue: O. m. g., Damon, seriously, step away from the trunk!
shots.tts: [alarmed urgent warning] Oh my god, Damon, seriously, step away from the trunk!

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide desert standoff shot: Damon stands ramrod-straight under his Heisenberg porkpie hat as a catastrophic, pressurized torrent of disgusting brown diarrhea erupts violently across the desert sand onto Hooman's loafers and SUV bumper.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on splattered, horrified Hooman clutching the useless speckled Magic Cone.
shots.dialogue: Dood... fuck that shit, dood! My loafers! You... you didn't even bend knee!
shots.tts: Dood... fuck that shit, dood! My loafers! You... you didn't even bend knee!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Serene, utterly unbothered Heisenberg MCU against crisp desert sky.
shots.dialogue: Facts. System cleared. Race weight locked. My Aquabike bike split just dropped four minutes.
shots.tts: [relaxed, victorious deadpan] Facts. System cleared. Race weight locked. My Aquabike bike split just dropped four minutes.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on Zach staring off-screen at the sand wreckage in quiet awe.
shots.dialogue: Well, I guess we don't need the Magic Cone after all.
shots.tts: [quiet bewilderment] Well, I guess we don't need the Magic Cone after all.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked Heisenberg MCU; wind brushes faintly beneath motionless glasses.
shots.dialogue: Your leverage just evaporated, Hooman. Put that cone back in your trunk. You distribute my brown meth—you get twenty percent.
shots.tts: [commanding, unyielding finale authority] Your leverage just evaporated, Hooman. Put that cone back in your trunk. You distribute my brown meth—you get twenty percent.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: MCU on intimidated, splattered Hooman under desert haze.
shots.dialogue: Twenty percent... after that? Dood... who the hell you think you are?
shots.tts: Twenty percent... after that? Dood... who the hell you think you are?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Signature slow closing Heisenberg push-in beneath dark porkpie hat.
shots.dialogue: You know exactly who I am. I cooked the brown meth, and I'm still making T-one on Sunday. Now... say my name.
shots.tts: [slow, iconic, terrifying Heisenberg cadence] You know exactly who I am. I cooked the brown meth, and I'm still making T-one on Sunday. Now... say my name.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Locked CU on deflated Hooman conceding softly.
shots.dialogue: ...Damon.
shots.tts: Damon.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Final razor-still Heisenberg close-up.
shots.dialogue: You're goddamn right.
shots.tts: [quiet, lethal certainty] You're goddamn right.
